calls.statement:
WITH n AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
SELECT n.store_id, c.store_name, c.sqm, c.format, ROUND(SUM(v),0) AS ns_fy2526,
 rank() over (order by SUM(v) desc) rk_sales, rank() over (order by c.sqm desc) rk_sqm
FROM n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date JOIN dim_store c ON c.store_id=n.store_id AND c.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY rk_sales LIMIT 15

calls.statement:
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sqm DESC) AS size_rank, store_id, store_name, sqm
FROM dim_store
WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900 AND close_date IS NULL
QUALIFY RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sqm DESC) <= 10
ORDER BY size_rank, store_id
